note: One authoritative writer per decision-state scope. Data collectors may coexist; only the named pipeline may publish the current authoritative state.

public_daily_observation.description: The verified daily public packet and snapshot pointer consumed by the Web workbench.

formal_research_version.description: The current publication of reviewed research versions.

valuation_review.description: G3/materiality decisions consumed only through the authenticated review workflow.

current_price_policy.description: Dated price-condition observations bound to the current publication.

private_ledger.description: User-confirmed private journal; locked until the local owner unlocks it.

excel_publication.description: The single canonical workbook. Currently a frozen 2026-10-01 snapshot, not live data.

pipelines.entry: Aliyun PostgreSQL scheduled pipeline (refresh-valuations, collect-filings, enrich-financials)
pipelines.recovery: Read-only consumption only. Any change to its schedule or schema requires explicit user approval.

conflict_policy.rule: A scope may have exactly one effective_authority writer. Non-authoritative writers must declare consumed_by_current_product=false and must not publish that scope.
